title: She told me to add more colors to the sky!
scene: 老师让他在画上加东西。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: What did the teacher say about your drawing?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: She told me to add more colors to the sky!

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Blue for the sky, and a big orange sun!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Ooh! What did the teacher say then?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: She told me to show it to the whole class tomorrow!

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I will hold it up high, like this!

variations: "add more colors" 换 "draw it bigger"；"orange sun" 换 "green tree"。
